proof_summary: At the seventh step the two preceding terms are \(171\) and \(N=(2^{171}+1)/9=332572817028187686275682948600327513806149983112761\), with \(N\equiv3\pmod{18}\). Since \(19\mid171\) and \(2^{18}\equiv1\pmod{19}\), one has \(2^N+1\equiv2^3+1=9\not\equiv0\pmod{19}\), so \(171\nmid2^N+1\).
